skill.displayName: AI Swimsuit Model – Virtual AI Bikini & Swimwear Fashion Showcase – API-powered
skill.summary: AI swimsuit model — transform a person photo into a swimsuit model image

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-swimsuit-model-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI swimsuit model skill.
- Supports uploading a person’s photo and transforming it into a swimsuit model image.
- Requires user API key for secure access; key must only be used with openapi.weshop.ai.
- Includes endpoints to start a run, poll status, and upload local images.
- Allows custom swimsuit scene instructions and batch processing (1–16 images).
- Detailed documentation provided on authentication, input, parameters, and usage.
